lines.beaver: 여기가 폐수 유출 신고가 들어온 곳이에요.
lines.beaver_en: This is where the wastewater leak was reported.
lines.beaver_roman: yeogiga pyesu yuchul singoga deureoon gosieyo.
lines.learner: 물 색깔 좀 보세요. 정말 참담하기 그지없네요.
lines.en: Look at the water's color. It's utterly devastating.
lines.roman: mul saekkal jom boseyo. jeongmal chamdamhagi geujieomneyo.

lines.beaver_en: They say factory waste flowed straight in.
lines.learner: 기름 찌꺼기까지 떠 있네요. 유출이 심각해요.
lines.en: Even oil residue is floating. The leak is serious.
lines.roman: gireum jjikkeogikkaji tteo inneyo. yuchuri simgakaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: How's the air? Should we measure it?
lines.learner: 매연 냄새가 심해요. 대기 오염도 걱정돼요.
lines.en: The smell of fumes is strong. I'm worried about air pollution too.
lines.roman: maeyeon naemsaega simhaeyo. daegi oyeomdo geokjeongdwaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Exhaust from nearby trucks is a problem too.
lines.learner: 배기가스 배출을 줄이지 않으면 온난화가 빨라져요.
lines.en: If we don't cut exhaust emissions, global warming speeds up.
lines.roman: baegigaseu baechureul juriji aneumyeon onnanhwaga ppallajyeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Acid rain falls often, so the trees have withered.
lines.learner: 산성비라니 안타깝기 그지없어요. 숲 보존이 시급해요.
lines.en: Acid rain—how terribly sad. Protecting the forest is urgent.
lines.roman: sanseongbirani antakkapgi geujieopseoyo. sup bojoni sigeupaeyo.

lines.beaver: 이 강에 살던 물고기도 거의 사라졌어요.
lines.beaver_en: The fish that lived in this river are almost gone.
lines.beaver_roman: i gange saldeon mulgogido geoui sarajyeosseoyo.
lines.learner: 이러다가 멸종하는 생물이 생길까 봐 무서워요.
lines.en: I'm scared some species might go extinct at this rate.
lines.roman: ireodaga myeoljonghaneun saengmuri saenggilkka bwa museowoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do the villagers separate their waste well?
lines.en: They just throw out recyclables. Waste sorting is a mess.

lines.beaver_en: What's the situation at the factory?
lines.en: They say frequent outages stop the purification equipment.

lines.learner: 설비를 고치고 태양열 발전도 쓰면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: I hope they fix the equipment and use solar power too.
lines.roman: seolbireul gochigo taeyangyeol baljeondo sseumyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Good idea. I'll be sure to put it in the report.
lines.en: I'll take notes too. Let's head back now.
